guard/30581.htm.text: Centurion Orinak: I, Orinak, am a Centurion. Let me give you a free word of advice... You may soon meet someone in the company of his minions... Don't get distracted by them! Got it? No matter what, only attack the leader!

links.text: "Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
